source.original_question:
An industrial site in the shape of a triangle is to take up the space between where three roads intersect.

Calculate the area of the site.

Round your answer to two decimal places.

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: The two marked roadsides50 and80 enclose44°. Trianglearea=(1/2)*50*80*sin44°=1389.3167..., rounds1389.32m².
